info.title: SightLine API
info.description: Tenant-scoped REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-token>`; the token selects one business and grants `<resource>:read` / `<resource>:write` scopes.

get.summary: List appointments in a time range

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. When following a cursor, the limit must remain unchanged.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next-page cursor returned by the previous response.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Range start; defaults to now.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Range end; defaults to 30 days after start.

parameters.name: technicianId
parameters.description: A technician id, or "me". Under a device session, "me" resolves to the caller's own Technician row (the filter is dropped entirely if the account has none). Under an API token, "me" is always rejected (400) — no session identity exists to resolve it against.

parameters.description: Delta-sync watermark: only rows updated strictly after this timestamp.
